items.title: Add readReviewRuns to the docs-drift-wrapper-root-smoke stub store
items.context: In packages/main/src/tasks/docs-drift-wrapper-root-smoke.ts makeStubStore (~159-190), add `readReviewRuns: () => ({ runs: [] })` to the returned stub object so collectReviewerEvidenceState (review-run.ts:868) no longer throws when the docs-drift preflight runs reviewerEvidenceAdvisoryGate. Mirror the shape used by review-incremental-context-smoke.ts. Do NOT change the production review-preflight gate or review-run.ts. Sibling stubs were audited: review-incremental-context already has it; review-convergence + authority-enforce-matrix do not hit the gate. Only this stub needs the method.
items.userSees: node packages/main/dist/tasks/docs-drift-wrapper-root-smoke.js runs the docs-drift preflight without TypeError and exits 0 (no "store.readReviewRuns is not a function").

happy.desc: node packages/main/dist/tasks/docs-drift-wrapper-root-smoke.js runs the preflight without TypeError and exits 0.

edge.desc: The stub readReviewRuns returns { runs: [] } so collectReviewerEvidenceState reads .runs without throwing.

adversarial.desc: Only the readReviewRuns method is added; every other stub field and the smoke own docs-drift assertions stay byte-identical (no perturbation).

verificationEvidence.note: Ran the smoke standalone: runs the docs-drift preflight without TypeError, prints "docs-drift wrapper-root smoke passed", exit 0.

makeStubStore now returns readReviewRuns: () => ({ runs: [] }) (plus readFindings/readReviewPasses/readScopeContract that collectReviewerEvidenceState transitively reads), so the gate reads .runs without throwing.
Only the reviewer-evidence stub methods were added; the rest of makeStubStore and the smoke own docs-drift assertions are byte-identical and still pass.

items.title: Full npm test returns to green
items.context: After the stub fix, full `npm test` must complete and exit 0 (the docs-drift-wrapper-root step passes and the chain runs to ALL PASS). This is the regression-resolution verification.
items.userSees: npm test exits 0 (ALL PASS), with test:docs-drift-wrapper-root passing instead of throwing TypeError: store.readReviewRuns is not a function.

happy.desc: Full npm test exits 0 (ALL PASS) with test:docs-drift-wrapper-root passing.

edge.desc: test:docs-drift-wrapper-root no longer throws TypeError: store.readReviewRuns is not a function.

adversarial.desc: No production file (review-preflight/review-run) changed; the fix is test-fixture only.

test:docs-drift-wrapper-root passes ("docs-drift wrapper-root smoke passed") instead of throwing TypeError: store.readReviewRuns is not a function.
